[=Supporting Projects=]

[.txt|SPO_CS/.] is the implementation center, but several sibling folders define how the repo is used outside the core compiler and VM path.
Use [<02_code_map.wiki|02_code_map.wiki>] for the main code map and [<../../index.wiki|../../index.wiki>] for top-level doc-set selection.

[=When To Leave SPO_CS=]

[| [*Path*] | [*Verified role*] | [*Inspect it when*] |]
[| [.txt|SPO/.] | sample host executable that references [.txt|SPO_CS.] and runs `.spo` programs | you need host embedding behavior instead of the raw compiler pipeline |]
[| [.txt|VSCode_Extension/.] | VS Code package, language client, language-server source, and local deployment workflow | editor integration, syntax registration, or LSP startup behavior matters |]
[| [.txt|TestRunner/FakeTestAdapter/.] | custom VSTest adapter that exposes [.txt|mTest.] tests to IDE tooling | IDE discovery or execution disagrees with the CLI host |]
[| [<../../index.html|index.html>] plus [.txt|js/.] | browser-based viewer stack for `.wiki`, `.spo`, `.ilt`, and mermaid-rich docs | the repo-local viewer or rendering behavior matters |]

When you only need parser, lowering, VM, or module behavior, stay in [.txt|SPO_CS/.].
Move into these siblings only for the corresponding integration surface.

[=SPO/: Example Host Embedding=]

[.txt|SPO/SPO.csproj.] is a small [.txt|net10.0.] executable that references [.txt|../SPO_CS/SPO_CS.csproj.].

[.txt|SPO/src/Program.cs.] currently:

- loads [.txt|Module_Std.]
- reads [.txt|aArgs[[0]].], defaulting to [.txt|src/_.spo.]
- injects [.txt|_StdLib.] and [.txt|_LoadModule....]
- resolves [.txt|_LoadModule....] relative to the current project file's folder
- runs the returned value through [.txt|mVM.Run(...).] with object [.txt|#IO ().]
- expects the final result to be [.txt|TRUE.]

[=VSCode_Extension/: Editor Tooling=]

Verified structure:

- [.txt|package.json.]
  registers language id [.txt|spo.] for [.txt|.SPO.], [.txt|.spo.], [.txt|.ILT.], and [.txt|.ilt.]
- [.txt|src/extension.js.]
  creates the client and starts [.txt|server/SPO.LSP.Server.exe.]
- [.txt|server-src/SPO.LSP.Server.csproj.]
  C# language-server source project
- [.txt|Deploy-LocalExtension.cs.]
  local build/install helper for the extension package

This keeps syntax registration, client startup, server source, and local deployment in one folder.

[=TestRunner/FakeTestAdapter/=]

This folder bridges the custom [.txt|mTest.] tree into the Visual Studio and VSTest model.

From the code:

- [.txt|FakeTestDiscoverer.]
  loads assemblies, finds public static [.txt|mTest.tTest.] fields, and flattens nested test groups into [.txt|TestCase.] items
- [.txt|FakeTestExecutor.]
  runs the stored delegate from [.txt|Test.LocalExtensionData.] and reports the result back to the platform

[=Browser Docs Viewer=]

The repo root ships a standalone documentation viewer:

- [<../../index.html|index.html>]
  bootstraps the browser UI, local-file fallback, and viewer loading
- [.txt|js/viewer.wiki.js.]
  wiki parser and renderer
- [.txt|js/viewer.spo.js.]
  syntax viewer for `.spo` and `.ilt`
- [.txt|js/viewer.mermaid.js.]
  mermaid integration
- [.txt|js/vendor/mermaid/mermaid.min.js.]
  vendored mermaid runtime

This viewer stack is the reason the repo can open the `.wiki` docs directly without an external wiki engine.

[=Secondary Text Guidance=]

[.txt|SPO_CS/src/Common/llms.txt.] exists, but it should be treated as secondary guidance only.

Reasons visible in the file and current tree:

- it still says [.txt|C# 13.] while [.txt|SPO_CS.csproj.] is pinned to [.txt|LangVersion = 14.0.]
- it only documents [.txt|src/Common/.], not the current doc split and outer tooling layers
- it is useful as a local note, not as the authoritative repo map

Prefer the code, [.txt|README.md.], and the current docs over [.txt|llms.txt.].
